sections.title: Put the present tense together
sections.content: You can now combine regular verbs, time expressions and simple questions to describe a normal day.

items.spanish: Trabajo por la mañana y estudio por la tarde.
items.english: I work in the morning and study in the afternoon.

items.spanish: Como en casa y camino por la tarde.
items.english: I eat at home and walk in the afternoon.
What do you do at night?

sections.content: Short connected sentences are enough. You do not need a complicated description of your day.
